title: Spurious Skill in Hybrid Stock Forecasting: code and audit materials
description: Code, notebooks and literature-audit materials for the article "Spurious Skill in Hybrid Stock Forecasting: A Fault-Injection Study with a Literature Audit" (Istikhor, Azman and Sangodiah, Taylor's University). Includes the verified reference pipeline (ARFIMA, LSTM, XGBoost; Serial, Parallel and Stacking hybrids), the eight fault switches (F1-F8), Diebold-Mariano test families and Monte Carlo, the diagnostic checks C1-C7, and the audit coding rules and build scripts.
